one_liner: Task, project, and workflow management platform with an extensive REST API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Free tier available with self-serve developer access and personal access tokens; paid plans unlock higher rate limits.
verdict_reason: Asana provides a fully documented REST API with self-serve personal access tokens and OAuth, plus an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: PATs are generated in the developer console. See the PAT documentation for more information.
Asana's REST API (base URL: https://app.asana.com/api/1.0) supports OAuth 2.0 and Personal Access Tokens for auth.
Because Personal is free, you can build and test against the API at no cost
Asana MCP is the official Model Context Protocol server for Asana, with OAuth and tools that cover tasks, projects, goals, portfolios, and teams.
Asana supports webhooks for resource-level events. Webhooks can be registered on workspaces, projects, tasks, and other resources.
